title: Discussion Quality Rubric
description: For threaded discussion participation. Volume is not the metric. Whether your posts move the thread forward is the metric.

levels.descriptor: Agreement, disagreement, or restatement with no added content.
Adds an example, a citation, or a clarification.
Advances the argument: a new framing, a counter-example, or a question the thread had not yet asked.
Reframes the disagreement so participants who held opposite views recognize the actual crux.
Replies that signal agreement or disagreement.
Replies that quote what was said and respond to its strongest version.
Replies that change the original poster's mind, or that publicly update the responder's own.
Curious AND willing to be wrong in public.
